question: Create a 20-beat visual lesson explaining how transformer language models learn. Follow one running sentence from tokenization and embeddings through positional encoding, query-key-value attention, softmax, multi-head attention, residual and normalization layers, feed-forward blocks, next-token prediction, cross-entropy loss, backpropagation, gradient descent, learning-rate effects, training versus inference, and generalization. Return exactly 20 beats.

lesson.title: How Transformer Language Models Learn
lesson.representation: Follow running example 'The cat sat' -> 'on'. Shared encodings: token blocks blue, vectors teal, position orange, attention weight=line thickness, correction signals red-purple. Chain: split text -> vectorize -> contextualize with attention -> deepen with blocks -> predict -> measure error -> send credit backward -> step weights -> contrast use vs learning. Methods shift with question: segmentation, vector construction, quantitative weighting, mechanism tracing, counterfactual comparison.
